title: 设计一张海报
prompt: 设计一张有视觉冲击力的植物主题海报，以盛开的红色花朵为主体，搭配醒目的大标题、自然纸张质感和暖色背景。保持清晰的视觉层次，文字准确可读，构图简洁，适合印刷。
promptEn: Design a striking botanical poster with a blooming red flower, a bold headline, natural paper texture, and a warm background. Keep a clear visual hierarchy, accurate readable typography, and a simple composition suitable for print.

title: 打造理想房间
prompt: 创建一幅等距视角的温馨客厅设计图，包含柔软沙发、木质家具、室内绿植和大窗户。使用自然光与柔和配色，突出材质细节和舒适氛围，完整展示房间的空间布局。
promptEn: Create an isometric view of a cozy living room with a soft sofa, wooden furniture, indoor plants, and large windows. Use natural light and gentle colors, emphasize material details, and show the complete room layout.

title: 设计品牌 Logo
prompt: 设计一个简洁且具有辨识度的品牌 Logo，以自然形态为灵感，使用少量几何元素和克制的配色。保持轮廓清晰，在小尺寸下依然易于识别，展示于干净的纯色背景上。
promptEn: Design a simple, distinctive brand logo inspired by natural forms. Use a few geometric elements and a restrained palette. Keep a crisp silhouette that remains recognizable at small sizes, presented on a clean solid background.

title: 绘制温暖插画
prompt: 绘制一幅温暖的手绘人物插画：一位微笑的年轻女性抱着黑白小猫，身穿柔软的黄色毛衣。采用橙粉色背景、细腻笔触与花朵装饰，保留自然表情和亲密互动，营造轻松治愈的氛围。
promptEn: Draw a warm illustration of a smiling young woman in a soft yellow sweater holding a black-and-white cat. Use an orange-pink background, delicate brushwork, and floral details. Preserve natural expressions and their affectionate interaction for a gentle, comforting mood.

title: 拍摄专业人像
prompt: 创作一张自然、专业的人像照片，采用柔和的影棚光线和干净的背景。保留真实的皮肤纹理、自然表情与准确的人体比例，使用简洁穿搭和舒适的半身构图。
promptEn: Create a natural professional portrait with soft studio lighting and a clean background. Preserve realistic skin texture, a relaxed expression, and accurate proportions, with simple styling and comfortable upper-body framing.

title: 制作一组图标
prompt: 设计一组风格统一的立体应用图标，使用圆润形状、柔和色彩和细腻材质。保持一致的视角、光照、留白与视觉重量，以整齐网格排布在简洁背景上，每个图标清晰易辨。
promptEn: Design a cohesive set of dimensional app icons using rounded forms, soft colors, and tactile materials. Keep perspective, lighting, spacing, and visual weight consistent. Arrange them in a neat grid on a simple background.

title: 给照片加上 80 年代风格
prompt: 使用我上传的照片，将人物呈现为 1985 年的复古照片风格。保留人物身份、面部特征、肤色、年龄和可辨识的外貌，重新设计发型、服装、配饰和周围环境，加入胶片颗粒、褪色调和直接闪光灯的质感。不要添加现代物品或文字。
promptEn: Using my uploaded photo, show me what I would have looked like around 1985. Preserve my identity, facial features, skin tone, age, and recognizable appearance. Reimagine my hair, clothing, accessories, and surroundings with mid-1980s styling, analog grain, faded colors, and direct flash. No modern objects or text.
